project.name: documenso
project.framework_detail: React Router v7 / Remix (apps/remix, flat routes with + folders), turbo monorepo
project.notes: Tokens are HSL triplets consumed as hsl(var(--x)) via packages/tailwind-config/index.cjs. Dark mode = class 'dark' on <html> (remix-themes, apps/remix/app/root.tsx:134). Variants live in cva() calls in TSX; there is no BEM CSS.

colors.name: --new-neutral-50..950, --new-primary-50..950, --new-info-50..950, --new-error-50..950, --new-warning-50..950
colors.value: 11-step ramps, not yet wired into tailwind config

typography.name: type scale in use
typography.value: Tailwind defaults: text-xs (badge, form error), text-sm (buttons, inputs), text-base (alert title), text-lg (dialog/card titles), text-2xl (flow step title), text-2xl/3xl (error page h1)

shadows.name: elevation usage
shadows.value: shadow-md (popover, select, dropdown, tooltip), shadow-lg (dialog, sheet, toast), shadow-2xl (command dialog)

motion.name: tailwindcss-animate
motion.value: animate-in/out, fade-in-80/90, slide-in-from-*, zoom-in-90 on overlays

motion.name: framer-motion
motion.value: form error enter/exit, dropzone, upsells, theme switcher

z_index.name: z-[1000]/z-[1001]
z_index.value: dialog portal / toast viewport, select content
